title: Thuppakki Munai
desc: Birla Bose, an encounter specialist, takes on a rape and murder case in Rameswaram. Upon discovering the accused's innocence, he embarks on a quest to uncover the true perpetrators.

title: Panchamugi
desc: Panchamukhi, a wife and mother, leaves her family devastated when she dies according to a prophecy by Goddess Durga. However, her grieving husband encounters an exact lookalike of her in the city.

title: IPC 376
desc: A police officer looks into an informer who can predict future murders in a mysterious way. Soon, she unearths a sinister murder mystery that leads to a shocking truth.

title: Rum
desc: After a heist, Shiva and his crew hide out in an abandoned bungalow. However, they are soon haunted by spooky occurrences.

title: The Raja Saab
desc: RajaSaab's search for his estranged grandfather leads him to a haunted mansion. He learns that his grandfather Kanakaraju, an exorcist, has laid a trap to lure him.

title: Kodiyil Oruvan
desc: An ordinary IAS aspirant, who helps out many misguided youths in his locality and shares a close bond with his mother, takes on a huge challenge when he opposes a powerful miscreant.

title: Aasamiyin America Payanam
desc: Accused of murder, a young priest manipulates his associates to flee to America, secretly motivated by the desire to chase after the love of his life.

title: Pallandu Vazhga
desc: An old couple living with their grandson yearn for the love of their children, who live abroad and hardly visit them. The frustrated couple hatch a plan to make their children come home.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Chakravyuham: The Trap
desc: Satya, an investigating officer, strives to overcome multiple challenges to solve the murder case of a businessman's wife.

title: Pogumidam Vegu Thooramillai
desc: A mortuary van driver tries to transport the body of an old man to a village but runs into several obstacles on the way.

title: Kaithi
desc: An ex-convict's fresh start to life is threatened by vengeful enemies, compelling him to confront the dangers for a chance at freedom.

title: Aruvam
desc: A woman with anosmia experiences paranormal events and soon finds herself involved in a series of mysterious murders linked to food adulteration.

title: Shadow
desc: Raghuram, a journalist, exposes the criminal activities of an infamous gangster, who later murders him as revenge. Years later, Rajaram, Raghuram's son, decides to track down the killer.

title: Avan Ivan
desc: A benevolent landlord embraces two half-brothers as his chosen family, nurturing their dreams, but their lives take a perilous turn when they cross paths with a notorious cattle smuggler.

title: Mirai
desc: When a vicious villain sets out to claim nine sacred books that hold the secret to immortality, the guardian of the ninth book ties a happy-go-lucky orphan's destiny to the quest to protect them.
